title: BIAS AND UNFAIRNESS IN MACHINE LEARNING MODELS: A SYSTEMATIC LITERATURE REVIEW
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review focusing on algorithmic bias and fairness in general machine learning models (such as classification and regression). While it addresses ethical concerns and justice as motivations for fairness research, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems. Furthermore, it does not specifically deal with Large Language Models (LLMs).
